_comment: Machine-readable UK tax rules consumed by the financial-plan engine. Figures are for the tax year below and must be kept in sync with reference/uk-tax-legislation.md (the sourced, human-readable version). Update both at the start of each tax year. All rates are decimals (0.20 = 20%). Region: England/Wales/NI (rUK). Scottish income tax is not modelled in v1.

savingsPropertyRates._note: Autumn Budget 2025: from 6 April 2027 savings income and property income are taxed at dedicated rates 2pp above the standard bands. The engine applies these to rental profit and savings interest from the fromYear tax year onwards.

corporationTax._note: Marginal relief between the limits is not modelled; the engine applies the small profits rate up to £50k and the main rate above.

stampDuty._note: England & NI SDLT, slice basis. Bands are [upperLimit, rate]; null = no upper limit. Scotland (LBTT) and Wales (LTT) not covered.
stampDuty._company_note: Companies buying residential always pay the additional-property surcharge on the banded rates. Over £500,000 a flat 17% applies instead UNLESS the company qualifies for relief (e.g. a genuine property rental business) — the calculator assumes a qualifying rental business and shows the 17% caveat. Figure per post-Oct-2024 rules; re-verify at the next tax-year update.
